character: Jura mountain ski area with 36km downhill, 130km cross-country. 4 sites: Lelex, Mijoux, Lamoura, La Faucille. Cross-country paradise with rolling forested terrain. Family-friendly, peaceful, excellent value. Geneva 40 min.

non_ski_activities.nordic: 130km cross-country trails — one of France's best Nordic areas. Forested rolling terrain.
non_ski_activities.downhill: 36km downhill runs, 4 sites, vertical drops up to 800m.
non_ski_activities.other: Snowshoeing, sledging, winter hiking. 40 min from Geneva. Family-friendly atmosphere.
